race.comment: CASTELLO GRANDE (1) drops back from stronger and is knocking on the door. Gets a key switch in Thompson and is drawn to be blending in at the right time. Won't get too many better chances than this. CELLPHONE (3) is building into this prep and profiles nicely for this fourth-up out to this trip. Interesting to see what Maloney does from the wide draw. TARADALE (9) is another one of the clear dangers after thrashing a Kilcoy BM58 4.7L only five days ago. This is obviously tougher but he gets in light and is drawn to give another bold sight. Is a chance to steal it if left alone in front. BILLS ANGEL (5) was run down late at Lismore after winning a CL1 there. Strips rock-hard fit and carries no distance queries. Only needs to hold her form to be right there again. DON STEFANO (4) savaged the line first-up when returning over the Sunny Coast 1800m. Better for that and rises to a winning trip second-up. Gets his chance to break a long run of outs.
